title: Silent together, restless apart
odia: ଦେଖିଲେ କଥା ନ କହେ, ନ ଦେଖିଲେ ପାଣି ନ ପିଏ
literal_meaning: On meeting, says nothing; without seeing, will not drink water.
explanation: The contradiction is the joke: someone seems distant in person but cannot settle when the other is absent.
meaning_odia: ସାମ୍ନାରେ ଥିଲେ କଥା କହୁନାହାନ୍ତି, ଦୂରେ ଗଲେ ମନ ଥୟ ହେଉନାହିଁ। ବାହାରର ଦୂରତା ଓ ଭିତରର ଟାଣର ଏହି ବିରୋଧାଭାସରେ କଥାଟିର ମଜା। ଏହା ଆଚରଣର ଅମେଳକୁ ଧରେ; ସେହି ମଣିଷର ମନ କଥା ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଜାଣିହୋଇଗଲା ବୋଲି ନୁହେଁ।
usage_example: Two friends barely speak during a visit, then immediately ask when they will meet again. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The source labels this ଢଗ under meeting. It names no relationship or reason for the silence.

witnesses.wording: ଦେଖିଲେ କଥା ନ କହେ, ନ ଦେଖିଲେ ପାଣି ନ ପିଏ

variants.locator: Uploaded compilation page26, four-line block beginning ନଡିଆ ଗଛରେ (comparison PDF271–272).
variants.note: User-confirmed riddle interpretation; main short saying retains its broader scope. Literal: There are no coconuts on the coconut tree; Dhadia sits with legs stretched out. When absent, he is sorely missed; when present, he is met with silence. ଅର୍ଥ: ଏହି ଚାରି ଧାଡ଼ିର ଧାଡ଼ାର ଉତ୍ତର ଜ୍ୱାଇଁ। ଶ୍ୱଶୁରଘରେ ଆଦର ପାଇ ସେ ଗୋଡ଼ ଲମ୍ବାଇ ଆରାମରେ ବସିଛନ୍ତି। ସେ ନଥିଲେ ଘରଲୋକ ତାଙ୍କୁ ଝୁରନ୍ତି, କିନ୍ତୁ ସାମ୍ନାରେ ଥିଲେ ସଂକୋଚରେ ବେଶି କଥା କହନ୍ତି ନାହିଁ। ନଡିଆ–ଧଡିଆ ଛନ୍ଦମିଳର ଆରମ୍ଭ; ନଡ଼ିଆ ଗଛକୁ ଧାଡ଼ାର ଆକ୍ଷରିକ ସଙ୍କେତ ଭାବେ ଧରିବା ଦରକାର ନାହିଁ। Explanation: The riddle points to a son-in-law, comfortably receiving hospitality at his in-laws’ home. They miss him when he is away but become reserved or shy in his presence. The rhyming opening sets up the verse rather than a coconut-tree clue. The humour turns on affection expressed differently in absence and presence; it does not describe every family. Source: uploaded compilation page26, inspected17November2026; exact four lines retained without repair. Source quotation excluded from collection CC licensing; upload licence unknown.

odia_summary: ସାମ୍ନାରେ ଦେଖିଲେ କଥା ନାହିଁ, ନଦେଖିଲେ ମନ ଥୟ ନାହିଁ—ଏହି ବିରୋଧାଭାସକୁ କଥାଟି ଧରିଛି।
english_summary: Someone stays silent in the other’s presence but cannot settle when they are apart.
